name: Willis
main_effect:
[On Play] [Start of Your Main Phase] 1 of your green Digimon gets +2000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.
[Your Turn] When one of your Digimon with [Terriermon] or [Lopmon] in its name is played, by suspending this Tamer, 1 of your Digimon with [Terriermon] or [Lopmon] in its name may digivolve into a Digimon card in the hand with the digivolution cost reduced by 2.
source_effect: Security Effect [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
